title: Introducing data residency in Europe
summary: Data residency builds on OpenAI’s enterprise-grade data privacy, security, and compliance programs supporting customers worldwide.
body: Data residency builds on OpenAI’s enterprise-grade data privacy, security, and compliance programs supporting customers worldwide.
summaryZh: OpenAI宣布在欧洲推出数据驻留（Data Residency）功能，进一步强化企业级的数据隐私、安全和合规支持能力，服务全球企业客户。原始信息显示：Data residency builds on OpenAI’s enterprise-grade data privacy, security, and compliance programs supporting customers worldwide.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“Introducing data residency in Europe”。其重要性主要体现在：OpenAI在欧洲推出数据驻留服务，满足企业级隐私与合规要求。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
